Name: Shorter Obelisks
Author: jimmyjules153
Description:
This is my first content pack! I started playing stardew a couple of weeks ago, and the vertical space of the Obelisks annoyed me because they block out a lot of things behind them. I love the art on the original obelisks, so I adjusted them to be half their original height. 

It supports all the obelisks that I know of, but if you know of one that I haven't done please let me know and I can make a short version 😊

The art on the shorter obelisks is rearranged and not just squashed to half height 💜

There's settings to enable/disable the mod for each obelisk, so you can have a couple shorter and a couple taller ones!

- Thanks to the Ridgeside Village team, especially ch20youk and Rafseazz for permission to use their beautiful obelisk art
- Thanks to the East Scarp mod team (uses obelisk from East Scarp mod) 
- Thanks to the Deepwoods mod team for their amazing obelisk art and the permission to use it
- Thanks to the Downtown Zuzu team, specifically for XxHarvzBackxX for their awesome obelisk art 
As you can see many people have helped in the creation of this content pack, be sure to go and check out their hard work! 💜
